notes.title: Crow Forest: New World is now the Full version.
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44516761/fa4d8c7f23a4510bfa66826fd6509e215d1db9b0.png[/img]
Specially for our transition to the Full Version, I have prepared some surprises for you on our new map. With each update, you'll be able to see hints of the next update as you explore the map.

Again, we will try to evaluate your ideas and add them to the game. For this reason, your comments are very important to us.

Switching to the full version does not mean that our work in the game is over, and we will continue to come up with innovations regularly.

If you have a problem with the opening of the game, deleting and reinstalling it will solve the problem.

notes.title: We're leaving Early Access on October 29th.
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44516761/fa4d8c7f23a4510bfa66826fd6509e215d1db9b0.png[/img]
Now you can play our game as a full version. I would like to thank everyone who supported us during the early access period. I will continue our work at the same pace and continue to make new updates and additions at short intervals. I am sure that with your support, we will turn into a much better game in a very short time. 

While welcoming you with a brand new map waiting to be discovered, I have added many edits with your feedback.

In our next update, you will be able to play the game in multiplayer.

I hope that we will bring Crow Forest: New World, which will turn into a much better game day by day, to the top with you.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44516761/a8831ba240cbd7cc7f385a29726c52e4be827b40.png[/img]
Best regards
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44516761/f6e8d8e4c9bf152f8dbf43fdcc0b9f9ed6451870.png[/img]

notes.title: NEW MAP!!!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44516761/fa4d8c7f23a4510bfa66826fd6509e215d1db9b0.png[/img]
We are aware of the fact that the map we are testing the mechanics with is very small and undetailed. While we continue to evaluate the suggestions and complaints from you, we can proudly say that we have simultaneously started the design of the main map of the game. You can continue to make suggestions to us so that we can prepare the additions you expect or want to be in the game to support us in this process. We will soon be sharing visuals from our new haita with you, thank you for your support and patience.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44516761/a8831ba240cbd7cc7f385a29726c52e4be827b40.png[/img]
We will continue to work to provide a much better gaming experience to all players and those who will join us on this path we have embarked on. We hope that they will be understanding and patient against all the disruptions that may occur in this process and that they will not withdraw their support for us.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44516761/a8831ba240cbd7cc7f385a29726c52e4be827b40.png[/img]

Best regards,
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44516761/f6e8d8e4c9bf152f8dbf43fdcc0b9f9ed6451870.png[/img]

notes.title: NOW IT'S YOUR TURN!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44516761/fa4d8c7f23a4510bfa66826fd6509e215d1db9b0.png[/img]
Crow Fores: New World" is advancing through its development stages while considering player input. 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44516761/a8831ba240cbd7cc7f385a29726c52e4be827b40.png[/img]
We invite you to influence the game's direction, aiming to offer the most enjoyable experience possible and align with your expectations. We are committed to earnestly incorporating all recommendations we receive. If you decide what should be in a survival game and provide us with feedback, we will do our best, and this will bring us together on common ground.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44516761/a8831ba240cbd7cc7f385a29726c52e4be827b40.png[/img]
If you've tried our game, you might have noticed that it's still in an early stage. Our primary aim is to enhance and progress it according to your preferences. In simpler terms, as players joining us on this journey, you can assist us in refining the game to its fullest potential. We'll review all the ideas and suggestions you send our way, develop a plan, and share it with you, making every effort to put them into action with the resources we have.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44516761/a8831ba240cbd7cc7f385a29726c52e4be827b40.png[/img]
So, please feel free to share your suggestions with us; we're eager to hear from you.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44516761/f6e8d8e4c9bf152f8dbf43fdcc0b9f9ed6451870.png[/img]

notes.title: Crow Forest: New World 0.0.6 Update
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44516761/fa4d8c7f23a4510bfa66826fd6509e215d1db9b0.png[/img]

With the new update, you must now find a flashlight that can follow the days and you will have to escape from the animals that attack you at night, otherwise the night may be difficult for you.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44516761/a8831ba240cbd7cc7f385a29726c52e4be827b40.png[/img]

- Day cycle added.
- Rain added.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44516761/a8831ba240cbd7cc7f385a29726c52e4be827b40.png[/img]

- Fixed the number of slots on wearables.
- Removed the refillable feature of bottles.
- Flasks rearranged as refillable
- Fixed the problem of mismatch between the icons and items on the wearables.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44516761/a8831ba240cbd7cc7f385a29726c52e4be827b40.png[/img]

There is still the possibility of corruption of save files in games as a result of the update, so we apologize in advance.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44516761/a8831ba240cbd7cc7f385a29726c52e4be827b40.png[/img]

In our next update, the map is planned to be expanded and many additions with new areas.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44516761/a8831ba240cbd7cc7f385a29726c52e4be827b40.png[/img]

We need your feedback to provide you with a better gaming experience. Thank you for your interest.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44516761/f6e8d8e4c9bf152f8dbf43fdcc0b9f9ed6451870.png[/img]
